# A trailing '*' on the name marks a Concentration / continuing-effect spell.

 1 | Identify Language | self | C | self | I
 2 | Remember | self | C | self | U

 8 | Restore Text I | 1 book | - | touch | E

17 | Restore Text II | self | - | touch | E

# Descriptions
@@ 1
While concentrating, caster can identify any written or spoken language.
@@ 2
Allows caster to completely recall anything he says, reads, or hears while
concentrating, for up to 1 month.
@@ 3
Caster may dictate to a blank page or book and his words will appear on the
page in his own handwriting (must have the appropriate writing knowledge for
the language). The caster’s words can be in any color and the caster can vary
the appearance (font, size, underline, etc.) at will.
@@ 4
Caster can read text written in an unknown language. The caster reads as
though he has rank 3 written in the language. This spell does not convey the
sounds of the language, only knowledge of the content of the text.
@@ 5
Causes any written text to be vocalized aloud in the language in which it is
written. It will be heard in the caster’s voice. This spell will only read up
to a rank 3 linguistic level. If the text is of a higher rank, any concepts
beyond rank 3 will be skipped, stuttered over, or incomprehensible. The caster
may stop concentrating on this spell to cast any of the Translation spells on
this list, and then resume the Phonics spell.
@@ 6
While concentrating, caster can understand and speak at rank 3 to any sentient
being with whom he is conversing. This spell only allows verbal communicating
(it is useless for trying to communicate to a race that only communicates
mentally or through motions). The caster gains no lasting knowledge of the
language; the spell magically translates the caster’s words into sounds the
being can understand and vice versa. If this spell is used in conjunction with
a Spoken spell, the caster can eventually learn the language. This requires
the caster to use these spells for at least 2 hours per day for 1 week.
@@ 7
Protects any one book or paper from normal wear and tear, aging, weathering,
etc.
@@ 8
Completely restores any non-magical book, or manuscript to its original
condition. This spell will not replace lost pages or missing parts of pages,
but will return faded or smeared pages to like new.
@@ 9
As Text Analysis III, except a text can be read to rank 5 of complexity.
@@ 10
As Spoken III, except the writing will be read at rank 5 of complexity.
@@ 11
As Translation III, except the caster can understand and respond at rank 5
complexity and, used in conjunction with Spoken spell, the caster can learn a
language.
@@ 12
Copies a book or document at the rate of 1 page per minute. The caster does
not need to open the book or read the pages, but he does need to supply the
paper to be written on.
@@ 13
As Text Analysis III, except a text can be read to rank 7 of complexity.
@@ 14
As Spoken III, except the writing will be read at rank 7 of complexity.
@@ 15
As Translation III, except the caster can understand and respond at rank 7 of
complexity and, used in conjunction with Spoken spell, the caster can learn a
language.
@@ 16
Caster knows the general direction (east, northeast, etc.) and approximate
distance to a non-magical text that he has seen or has been given a detailed
description of. This description should contain at least the title, author and
general topic of the text.
@@ 17
As Restore Text I, except will affect magical books.
@@ 18
As Text Analysis III, except a text can be read to rank 10 of complexity.
@@ 19
As Spoken III, except the writing will be read at rank 10 of complexity.
@@ 20
As Translation III, except the caster can understand and respond at rank 10 of
complexity and, used in conjunction with Spoken spell, the caster can learn a
language.
@@ 25
Instantly makes a complete copy of a non-magical manuscript (25 pages or
less). The caster must have sufficient blank paper to make the copy. Multiple
castings of this spell can copy larger manuscripts.
@@ 30
Will restore any text to new condition so long as at least half of it is
present. This will repair any damage other than lost or completely destroyed
pages. Any pages that are lost or destroyed will be replaced by a page that is
a 75% correct replication of the original page.
@@ 50
As Locate Text, except will work for magical texts.
